data.description: If a bearded devil hits a single opponent with both claw attacks, it also lashes at the same target with its spiky, filthy beard. The victim takes 1d8+2 points of damage and must succeed on a DC %1 Fortitude save or contract devil chills. Devil Chills: Disease--injury; save Fort DC %1; onset 1d4 days; frequency 1/day; effect 1d4 Str damage; cure 3 consecutive saves.
